tha-ap431:1.1: samattaṃ. [426. Sovaṇṇakiṅkhaniya.] Saddhāya abhinikkhamma pabbajim anagāriyaṃ / vākacīradharo āsiṃ tapokammam apassito. // //
tha-ap431:2.1: Atthadassī tu bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / uppajji tamhi samaye tārayanto mahājanaṃ. // //
tha-ap431:3.1: Balañ ca vata me khīṇaṃ vyādhinā paramen' ahaṃ / Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ saritvāna puline thūpam uttamaṃ, // //
tha-ap431:4.1: Karitvā haṭṭhacitto 'haṃ sahassena samokiriṃ / soṇṇakiṅkhanipupphāni uddaggamanaso ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap431:5.1: Sammukhā viya sambuddhaṃ thūpaṃ paricarim ahaṃ / tena cetopasādena Atthadassissa tādino // //
tha-ap431:6.1: Devalokagato santo labhāmi vipulaṃ sukhaṃ / suvaṇṇavaṇṇo tatthāsiṃ Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap431:7.1: Asītikoṭiyo mayhaṃ nāriyo samalaṅkatā / sadā mayham upaṭṭhanti Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap431:8.1: Saṭṭhiṃ turiyasahassāni bheriyo paṇavāni ca / saṅkhā ca deṇḍimā tattha vaggu vadati dundubhi. // //
tha-ap431:9.1: Cullāsītisahassāni hatthino samalaṅkatā / tidhappabhinnamātaṅgā kuñjarā saṭṭhihāyanā // //
tha-ap431:10.1: Hemajālābhisañchannā upaṭṭhānaṃ karonti me / balakāye gaje c' eva ūnatā me na vijjati. // //
tha-ap431:11.1: Soṇṇakiṅkhanipupph*ānaṃ* vipākam anubhon' ahaṃ / aṭṭhapaññāsakkhattuñ ca devarajjam akārayiṃ. // //
tha-ap431:12.1: Ekasattatikkhāttuñ ca cakkavatti ahos' ahaṃ / pathavyā rajjam ekasataṃ mahiyā kārayim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap431:13.1: So dāni patto amatam asaṅkhataṃ sududdasaṃ / *saṃyojan* aparikkhīṇo n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. // //
tha-ap431:14.1: Aṭṭhārase kappasate yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap431:18.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sovaṇṇakiṅkhaniyo thero i. g. a-ti.
